title: Cream of Green Peas Soup
description: Cream of Green Peas Soup is a smooth and velvety Continental soup made with tender green peas, aromatic vegetables, and finished with fresh cream. It offers a delicate sweetness, vibrant green color, and a rich, creamy texture, making it an elegant appetizer.

ingredients.title: For the Soup
items: Leek, white part only, sliced – 1 (optional, for depth of flavor)
Fresh parsley or mint leaves – for garnish

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Aromatics
steps: Heat butter in a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion and leek, sauté gently until translucent (do not brown).
Add minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds until fragrant.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Cook the Peas
steps: Add the green peas and stir for 2–3 minutes to coat with the butter and aromatics.
Pour in the stock, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to a simmer.
Cook for 10–12 minutes, until peas are tender but still vibrant in color.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Blend to Smoothness
steps: Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Blend the soup in batches in a high-speed blender until silky smooth.
Strain through a fine mesh sieve if you want an extra-smooth, velvety texture.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Finish with Cream
steps: Return the soup to low heat.
Stir in fresh cream, season with salt, white pepper, and nutmeg.
Heat gently—do not boil after adding cream to avoid curdling.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Serve
steps: Garnish with a swirl of cream, a few whole blanched peas, and fresh parsley or mint leaves.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot with crusty bread or garlic crostini.
Garnish with a swirl of fresh cream and blanched peas.
Enjoy as an elegant appetizer or a light meal.

chefTips: Add a pinch of baking soda to the cooking water or stock to keep the peas bright green.
Strain the blended soup through a fine mesh sieve for an extra-smooth texture.
For a lighter version, replace part of the cream with milk or omit it entirely for a Potage Saint-Germain style.
Do not boil the soup after adding the cream to prevent curdling.
